big: A client gets ₹30,000 as IDCW from a fund and thinks it is a bonus on top of her returns. It is her own money paid back, and it is added to her income and taxed at her slab rate. In a 30% slab, that is ₹9,000 of tax.

lines: Why did tax get cut from my payout, and what do I keep for filing?
IDCW is the current name for a payout. It is taxed in your hands at slab rates, and TDS can be cut once payouts cross a limit. Keep your statements, since they feed your return.

rows: No payout, no tax until units are sold
note: Rates and limits are as per current rules and change with Budgets. Confirm each year.
